name: Cypress Hill
hook: A Latino rap group from Los Angeles whose smoky, squealing, DJ Muggs-built sound sold millions and crossed over to rock crowds.

blurb.age7: A rap group from Los Angeles with a DJ called Muggs. Their songs have a strange squealing sound that people remember.
blurb.age13: B-Real, Sen Dog and DJ Muggs came together in South Gate, near Los Angeles, in 1988. B-Real's family is Mexican and Cuban, Sen Dog was born in Cuba, and Muggs grew up in Queens before moving west. B-Real raps in a high, nasal voice over Muggs's murky, slowed-down beats. Their first album came out on Ruffhouse in 1991, and 'Insane in the Brain' in 1993 was a huge hit. They also campaigned openly for making marijuana legal.
blurb.adult: Cypress Hill brought Latino rappers to the top of the charts and later toured with rock and metal bands, crossing audiences the way Run-D.M.C. had. Muggs's production is the centre of the sound. The famous squeal in 'Insane in the Brain' is itself sampling lore: it is widely said to be a horse from a Mel and Tim record, but Muggs has said in interviews, including a Sound on Sound feature in 2018, that he made it by pitching a blues guitar sample. That dispute is unresolved here.Their campaigning for marijuana legalisation was public and long-running.
